reviews.text: I adopted a 1 1/2 yro rescue that was difficult and at times scary due to his aggressive behavior. I was truly at my wits end and was questioning my decision to adopt him. I have always had dogs but this guy had a mind of his own.  Ari and his staff worked diligently with him and after his training was concluded, gave me back a lovable and well behaved dog.  Not only did they train my dog but they trained me on commands and actions needed to reinforce his behavior.  I now have a dog that LISTENS to me and is an absolute pleasure to be with.  I cannot say enough good things about Downtown Dogs Chicago, Ari and his staff. They are miracle workers!

Unfortunately Downtown Dogs did not meet my expectations. I paid a deposit for the 3 week board and train package, and then paid the remainder of the fee in full, in advance. I was told that it was best that my pup was closer to a year old behold said training should start, and I understood that logic. After the year passed, I decided that my puppy was not go to participate, and I contacted Ari for a refund of the second -in full- payment (not the deposit). He insisted on speaking to me first, did not call when he said he would, and when he finally did call me, he was abrasive and rude. He claimed the payment was non refundable despite NO written claims of this anywhere. He sent me screenshots of my payment stating it said non-refundable, which it did not. I still have not received my refund. Highly disappointed in this non professional behavior.
The training program is 10/10. My dog was reactive and it was becoming a huge issue. Since she completed her training she is a different dog. Worth every penny and time spent.

We couldn't be happier with the training our puppy received at Downtown Dogs! We are constantly getting compliments from friends and family how well trained he is, especially how easy he is to walk on a leash. The only place we take him for boarding, too. Highly recommend!

I took my Staffie (Doug) to Downtown Dogs for their Board and Train program. Ari, Aliya, and their team are very knowledgeable and worked with Doug on improving his listening and recall skills. I love that they have group classes to help reinforce what he learned and to teach me how to effectively communicate with him. They offer boarding programs too so I know that I always have a safe, reliable place for Doug to stay when I’m out of town. And, added perk, this is the only place where Doug will allow his nails to be trimmed!

I called the store but a machine answered and the person who answered sounded despotic and aggressive, it seemed like he was talking to animals but he didn't realize that he was answering calls. If that's how it is with people, I can't imagine what it must be like with them. dog parents

Downtown Dogs Chicago has changed our and our dog’s life forever.
They are worth every penny and more !
Our bulldog was reactive to other dogs and had fear aggression.
We did private behavioral classes with A trainer at another facility and group ones which did not correct any of the issues.
He was kicked out of day care and we were sad and desperate.
A friend recommended Downtown Dogs and our lives turned for the better.
Henry  went through the training and the dog we got back was A completely different animal.
2 years later we still go to group classes once in A while and have kept up with everything we were taught.
Thank you to all the trainers , Ari and Aliya

This review is LONG overdue!! We brought our chow/pit mix here due to her herding / feet nipping habits/ playtime nipping and the trainers here completely transformed my dog. She was a tough cookie to crack and not food motivated AT ALL but the trainers here were so patient. Our dog is now super well behaved, understands boundaries, and is very obedient!  10000% worth the investment!
